integrity: Complete analytic proof and two finite reproducibility checks are supplied. Finite checks are not proofs of infinite statements. Historical-priority searches are not uniqueness certification. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
limitations: Real graph-distance Lipschitz operators for two-subset Kneser graphs with n>=5, unweighted graph, unit-rate unnormalized heat; does not cover higher-subset Kneser graphs, nonuniform edge lengths or W_p for p!=1. Historical priority may be qualified by an unlocated equivalent publication.
title: Exact signed-filter Lipschitz norms and finite-time heat contraction on two-subset Kneser graphs
